'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***At least 23 [[Palestinians]] are killed, including three children, in overnight [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s on [[Gaza City]], [[Palestine]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/israel-hamas-war/article/israeli-airstrikes-kill-23-in-gaza-as-outcry-over-aid-blockade-grows/ (CTV News)]
*[[2025 India–Pakistan conflict]]
**[[Pakistan]] announces [[Operation Bunyanun Marsoos]], the start of large-scale military action against [[India]].    [https://www.samaa.tv/2087433227-operation-bunyan-um-marsus-pakistan-attacks-india-with-counter-strikes (Samaa.tv)]
**[[Pakistan Air Force]] warplanes launch [[airstrike]]s throughout India with missile strikes targeting [[Udhampur]], [[Pathankot Airport]] and a [[BrahMos]] missile storage facility in [[Beas City]], [[Punjab, India|Punjab]]. PAF reportedly downed 6 india jets including S 400 battery. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/5/10/india-pakistan-live-pakistan-airbases-targeted-as-blasts-rock-north-india (Al Jazeera)]
**A Pakistani [[Fatah (multiple rocket launcher)#Fatah-II|Fatah-II]] missile is intercepted over the city of [[Sirsa]] in the Indian state of [[Haryana]]. [https://www.news18.com/india/india-cities-high-alert-pakistan-operation-bunyan-ul-marsoos-fateh-2-missile-intercepted-sirsa-operation-sindoor-latest-news-ws-l-9330892.html (News18)]
**India announces the temporary closure of its airspace over the northern and western regions of the country until May 14. [https://aje.io/pw1um1?update=3699354 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[United States]] [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] and Pakistani [[Deputy Prime Minister of Pakistan|Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Ishaq Dar]] announce a full and immediate [[ceasefire]] between India and Pakistan, mediated by the U.S. Indian [[Foreign Secretary (India)|Foreign Secretary]] [[Vikram Misri]] later confirms the ceasefire as well. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cwy3jnl3nvwt (BBC News)]
**Violations of the ceasefire and new clashes are reported shortly after the announcement of the agreement. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/pakistan-says-three-air-bases-targeted-by-indian-missiles-2025-05-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***At least 20 prisoners are killed and 45 others are injured in an [[airstrike]] by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] on a prison in Obeid, [[North Kordofan]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/a-suspected-rsf-strike-hits-a-prison-killing-at-least-19-in-sudan-officials-say/ (CTV News)]
*[[Ecuadorian conflict (2024–present)|Ecuadorian conflict]]
**[[Ecuador]] announces a [[National day of mourning|three-day mourning period]] after eleven soldiers are killed in an ambush by guerrillas. [https://newsexpressngr.com/news/260738/guerrillas-kill-11-soldiers-in-ambush (News Express)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least seven people die and others are injured over two districts in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], after a [[flood]] triggered by severe rainfall sweeps infrastructure including [[Aden Adde Airport]]. The rain also collapses nine houses and floods over 200 others. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/seven-dead-after-heavy-rain-hit-mogadishu-friday-2025-05-10/ (Reuters)] [https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/science-environment/3377961-devastating-floods-ravage-mogadishu-claiming-lives-and-altering-infrastructure  (Devdiscourse)]
*Four people are injured and 150,000 people are issued health warnings and stay-indoors orders when a [[chemical plant]] catches fire in [[Vilanova i la Geltrú]], [[Catalonia]], [[Spain]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/climate-and-environment/article/fire-at-chemical-plant-in-northeastern-spain-keeps-thousands-indoors/ (CTV News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[government of Bangladesh]] bans the [[Awami League]] party of former [[Prime Minister of Bangladesh|Prime Minister]] [[Sheikh Hasina]], who was ousted [[2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement|last year during mass protests]], before her flight to [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bangladesh-hasina-yunus-awami-league-78b40dfe9c92257f0042968c7b963c2a (AP)]
